# R3GC job tables (generated by gen/r3gen.py)

Each job: name (set, render_pb_pages P, regtimeline), the exact tool command and the frozen predictions.  The tool is `$T`
(~/sgxfive-test-r1), the work directory `$W`.  `set`: control, fit, heldout, repeat, replicate.  `tables/` is the runner's
input; this is a view (the count tables of g-qf and g-qh list the predicted counts per cell, the full 20-pair table is in
`predictions/`).

## g-z: 15 jobs, 15 conditions

```
C1 (zls, Q287 closes Q122 with it): the ZLS store's band at other alignments. E730 (post hoc, 12
of 12 jobs; every width 2 mod 4, every height 2 mod 8) found the stored (not 1.0f) dwords of a
full-screen triangle's depth store at x < 1.25 W and y < 1.25 H of the tile area. Frozen rule A:
the pixel centre test x + 0.5 < 1.25 W, i.e. x < ceil(1.25 W - 0.5), and the same for y with H,
against FLOOR (x < floor(1.25 W)), ROUND (x < floor(1.25 W + 0.5)), CEIL (x < ceil(1.25 W)) and
RSTRICT (x + 1 < 1.25 W). DEVIATION from the proposal: the tool refuses odd sizes (render.c: width
% 2, height % 2 -> EINVAL; the Mac mock says `render: Invalid argument` for 17, 19, 33, 35 and
heights 17, 19, 21), so the fractions .25 and .75 of 1.25 W (where A differs from FLOOR) cannot be
run: the nearest accepted shape is the integer fraction (W = 0 mod 4: 20, 36, 44, 76; H = 0 mod 4:
20, 28, 36), where A = FLOOR = ROUND = CEIL and only RSTRICT differs (RSTRICT agrees with A at
E730's .5 and so was not refuted); the new alignments also put the band's edge at other places of
the 32 x 16 tile (W = 76: 95 of the 96 pixels of three tiles). The controls (34 x 18 x and y, 66 x
34: E730's .5 sizes) separate A from ROUND and CEIL. Rows: E730's isp-a-guard rows (p1141/isp-a-
guard.sh) with the sizes changed: the same option string, the depth pitch per width as E730 chose
it (0x17100c up to 64, 0x171014 at 66 and 76), the buffer pre-filled with 0xdeadbeef, a depth
dump. Observable: a tile-area dword is stored iff it is not 1.0f (E465's, as E730's post hoc
reader). Gates, from the kept dump: no dword of the tile area still 0xdeadbeef (the store writes
whole tiles), the tool's own `diff: 0 of W*H pixels`. A control miss voids the stage. The pa0
iterated-attribute clause of Q287 is not run (user decision R3-R5 c). z-tri-in / z-tri-cross: one
triangle by --tri-v; the model is the pixel-centre raster clipped by the band (edge pixels within
1/16 pixel are ambiguous).
```

## g-qf: 22 jobs, 22 conditions

```
C2 fit stage (Q211): the count of partial renders of the default triangle at 4096x4096 (U = 287)
at the 19 cells where the 20 (k, s) pairs that fit E625's 10 and E779's 9 cells together
(closing3/rank/q211_fit.out) predict different counts, with E625's 0xa0 (2), 0xb0 (1) and E779's
0xa3 (1) as controls. The counts are those of E625's family 1 + floor((U + k - thr0) / (thr0 +
s)), thr0 = P - 0x22; the grid holds k in [-8, 0], s in [0x1b, 0x1e]. The 19 cells leave 13
classes of pairs (some pairs predict the same counts at U = 287 everywhere: e.g. (-8, 27) and (-7,
27)); the held-out stage g-qh separates every one of the 20. Run from the highest P down (the
fewest partial renders first, up to 10 at 0x24). Knob proof: the job's own 0x0624 = P - 0x22. A
count that rises with P, a hang or a failed control stops the reading (the runner stops at a
hang).
```

## g-qh: 14 jobs, 14 conditions

```
C2 held-out stage (Q211): the scenes of E773 with U = 275 (-n 1 --move 1:1024,0) and U = 438 (-n 2
--geometry 1 --move 2:0,1024) at 4096x4096. Two scene-gate jobs at the default P = 0x422 read each
scene's U (the peak of 0x0724) as E773 did; a scene whose U differs voids its cells. Six cells a
scene, chosen offline (gen/r3_geo.py pick_heldout): greedily the cells that split the 13 classes
the fit leaves until every one of the 20 pairs is its own class, then the most divisive, and one
cell where all 20 pairs agree (a plain test of the family at the new U). The frozen table holds
the predicted count of every pair at every cell; the scorer keeps the pairs the fit stage left
(g-qf's kept data) and scores the held-out cells against them. A job with a kick lost (`#N:
overflowed` for a render before the last) is void (E773's rule). Run after g-qf.
```
